audit.whatIsWrong: The chart handed Volibear levels 2 through First item and gave K'Sante nothing, while the why strings for those same rows say 'a wash', 'you win the trade', 'you out-position', 'coin-flip', 'neither stomps lane'. The packet chart and the 51.69% win rate over 797 games agree with the whys, not the sides.
audit.why: K'Sante's level-3 Q-W beats a Volibear whose only stun, Thundering Smash, is on 12s at rank 1. Volibear's ownership is late, once Frenzied Maul heals through tank damage.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Skill / Volibear.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes carried no cooldown numbers and mis-stated where Volibear's power sits at 6.
audit.why: Thundering Smash 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, Frenzied Maul 5s flat, Sky Splitter 16s flat, Stormbringer 160/135/110s. His level-6 threat is the tower disable and bonus health, not a shield on R.
audit.corrected: Spikes now name the abilities with real cooldowns and place Stormbringer's tower disable at the dive spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors. (a) The text calls Sky Splitter (E) a 'hand-of-the-god stun' repeatedly — Riot's text says it damages, slows, and shields Volibear if he stands in the blast; the stun is Thundering Smash (Q). (b) It claims K'Sante's W charge is 'unstoppable'. (c) It says Frenzied Maul slows; it does not, and it only heals on the second cast against the same target.
audit.why: Sky Splitter: 'summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.' Thundering Smash: 'gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks' — and it carries the autoReset flag, so his combo opens on an attack wind-up. K'Sante's W text says only 'taking reduced damage' — unstoppable is not in the data. Frenzied Maul applies on-hit and heals on the repeat cast.
audit.corrected: E is a slow-and-shield you fight outside of; Q is the stun and the attack-reset tell; W is a repeat-cast heal that Grievous Wounds answers.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already core in the item line, which is right — Frenzied Maul's repeat-cast heal is the flagged missing interaction.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds is now also tied to the level-6 all-in where it decides the result.

edits.before: Level 1 you both just farm — you only have Q and no engage, and Voli's Q dash plus E stun mean you don't want to facecheck a trade before your combo is online. The lane swings your way at Level 3 once Q-W is up: bait his Q dash in, W-charge to eat the bite, then Q3 to knock him up and pull him before his E stun comes online. Respect his W bite range — it slows and heals him, so don't drop into a long auto trade you can't finish.
edits.after: Level 1 you both just farm — you only have Q and no engage, and Thundering Smash stuns the first thing he attacks, so don't facecheck a trade before your combo is up. At Level 3 it swings your way: bait the dash, W-charge for your own stun, then pull him in with the 2-stack Ntofo. Watch his auto wind-up, not the cast — his Q is an attack reset. Respect Frenzied Maul: the second bite on the same target heals him, so never start a trade you cannot finish.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your control window: you out-position his short Q dash, bank Q stacks, and your bulk shrugs off poke he can't sustain back without W. Trade on his W-bite cooldown, not into it. At 6 his E hand-of-the-god stun is the trap — if he lands it he chains a full bite combo, so save W's unstoppable charge to break the stun timing, and only commit R All Out once his E and W are down, because the moment you ult you give up the armor that keeps you alive in his brawl.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your control window: you out-position his 300-range Q dash, bank Ntofo stacks, and your bulk shrugs off chip he can only heal back with a second Frenzied Maul. At 6 the trap is Sky Splitter — 16s flat, it slows you and shields him if he stands in the blast, which is his cue to commit. Fight outside that circle, buy Grievous Wounds, and commit All Out only once his Q stun is down, because the moment you ult you give up the armour that keeps you alive in his brawl.

edits.before: This is where Voli reclaims it. Full-build his W bite heals straight through your tank damage and his sustained even-brawl profile out-grinds your stripped All Out form, while his R shield plus tower disable wins any dive around objectives. Stop trying to solo him — flip your R into a peel tool, charge in with W, and recast All Out to yank him off your carry rather than betting on a 1v1 his sustain wins. Bank your mid-game lead into objectives before his scaling and dive take over.
edits.after: This is where Voli reclaims it. Full-build a repeat Frenzied Maul heals straight through your tank damage and out-grinds your stripped All Out form, while Stormbringer's bonus health and tower disable win any dive around objectives. Stop trying to solo him — carry Grievous Wounds, flip R into a peel tool, and use it to launch him off your carry rather than betting on a 1v1 his sustain wins. Bank your mid-game lead into objectives before his scaling takes over.

notes: Corrected a false ability: the text called Sky Splitter (E) a stun ('hand-of-the-god stun'). It slows and shields Volibear; the stun is Thundering Smash (Q). Also removed the 'unstoppable' claim for K'Sante's W (Riot's text says only reduced damage) and the claim that Stormbringer shields (it grants bonus health and disables towers).
